info.title: Meziantou.Framework.PublicApiGenerator.Tool
info.description: CLI to generate compilable C# public API stubs from .NET assemblies.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generate public API stubs from a .NET assembly.

options.name: --input
options.description: Assembly input. Use either 'path' or 'tfm=path'. Repeat for multi-target generation.

options.name: --output-file
options.description: Output file path when --file-layout is SingleFile

options.name: --file-layout
options.description: File layout: SingleFile, OneFilePerNamespace, or OneFilePerType [default: SingleFile]

options.name: --omit-auto-generated-comment
options.description: Omit the // <auto-generated/> comment from generated files

options.name: --include-assembly-references
options.description: List the names of the referenced assemblies in the header of generated files. With a .deps.json file, the assemblies of the framework are not listed

options.name: --include-assembly-reference
options.description: Pattern of the names of the framework assemblies to list with --include-assembly-references ('*' and '?' wildcards). Repeat for several patterns.

options.name: --exclude-assembly-reference
options.description: Pattern of the names of the assemblies not to list with --include-assembly-references ('*' and '?' wildcards). Repeat for several patterns.

options.name: --include-all-attributes
options.description: Write the attributes that are not written by default: EditorBrowsable, the attributes of other namespaces than System, and the assembly attributes

options.name: --delete-unexpected-files
options.description: Delete the files of the --output directory that are not generated, such as the files of removed types. Only use it when the directory only contains the generated files

options.name: --verify-no-change
options.description: Verify generated files are up to date without writing changes
